provenance: Independently authored complete 34-scene showreel: Canvas bounce/squash, kinetic text masks/wipes, radial lattice wave, 1480 3D sphere-to-torus-to-wave points, dedicated WebGL liquid SDF shader, 5100 MOTION particles, rapid geometric rhythm cuts and final CLAUDE resume card. No original image, video or full-frame sequence loaded. Original soundtrack comparison only.
editable: project.json palette/marks/chronology;composition.js dedicated geometry, particle mappings and metaball shader
differences: OFL ArchivoBlack/InstrumentSerif/JetBrains substitutes have different glyph outlines, weight and tracking from original; some word bounding boxes and repeated masks differ.
Bounce arc, squash, ellipse shock rings, timing diamonds and trails are independently simulated with approximate event timing.
Point grid timing wave and easing inset curve are authored; cell rotations/colors and blue flood edge differ.
1480 real three-dimensional points morph from Fibonacci sphere into torus and rippling plane; source camera, angle phase, plane height and motion blur differ.

Liquid is an authored WebGL smooth-union signed-distance-field raymarch with five moving centers and blended lighting. Original exact metaball shapes, color hotspots, reflections, shadow and camera are not recovered.
5100 particles independently assemble and disperse into sampled MOTION lettering; exact stochastic field and glyph density differ.
Rectangle tunnel/halftone/stripes/beat counter/RGB split/sunburst/tiles/type-wall are rendered from geometry. Source fast-cut motion blur, chromatic softness and graphic spacing differ.
Original stream is 897 frames at 60fps (14.95s); 30fps export quantizes to 449 frames (14.966667s). Reference UI timecode is independently recalculated and differs from original display frame jitter.
Original reference soundtrack is included only for comparison, not independently authored.
